title: Grilled Argentinean Seafood Skewers with Italian Twist
description: A flavorful and colorful Italian-inspired dish featuring marinated seafood skewers grilled to perfection. This recipe combines the freshness of seafood with the bold flavors of Argentina and Italy.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Add the shrimp and scallops to the marinade, and mix well to coat.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap, and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or up to 2 hours.
Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
Thread the marinated shrimp and scallops onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the grill grates with olive oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, or until the seafood is cooked through.
Meanwhile, grill the mozzarella balls for 1-2 minutes on each side, or until lightly toasted.
To assemble the dish, place a grilled mozzarella ball on each plate, and top with a skewer of seafood.
Garnish with chopped parsley, and serve immediately.
